new_libraries.name: UltrasonicFilter
new_libraries.author: steve daniels
new_libraries.paragraph: A simple to use filter that removes false readings from ultrasonic sensors. This filter exploits hardware latency and timeout parameters to remove spurious readings.  This is V1.0 API may change in future.  Depends upon Ultrasonic library by Erik Simoes https://github.com/ErickSimoes/Ultrasonic

library.name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
library.author: Aung Moe Khine
library.sentence: Universal standalone TFT, touch, sprite, TFT_eSPI_Button, gradients, and visual GUI driver with 1-line autoSetup and adaptive multi-point autoCalibrate for ESP32 CYD resistive & capacitive boards and ESP32-S3 RGB capacitive boards.
library.paragraph: Bundles high-speed display and touch drivers with runtime hardware auto-probing for 2.4", 2.8", 3.2", 3.5", and 4.0" CYD resistive and capacitive boards (ILI9341, ST7789, ST7796, XPT2046, GT911, CST820) and ESP32-S3 parallel RGB boards (4.3", 5.0", 7.0" 800x480 ST7262 + GT911 capacitive touch). Features 1-line universal hardware auto-setup (tft.autoSetup()), adaptive multi-point statistical touch calibration with NVS persistence (tft.autoCalibrate()), built-in ambient light auto-dimming with LDR moving average filtering (tft.adjustBrightness()), universal Active-LOW RGB LED control (tft.setRgbLed()), dual touch controller auto-detection, half-duplex SPI readback on SDA, persistent NVS hardware overrides, full TFT_eSPI and TFT_eSPI_Button drop-in compatibility, linear vertical & horizontal color gradients, alpha blending, TFT_eSprite off-screen buffering, zero-boilerplate LVGL v8/v9 integration, PlatformIO/Visual Studio support, and seamless SquareLine Studio / EEZ Studio visual GUI builder support.
